sources.title: Project After contributors: hand-set species values
sources.licence: project contribution under the repository's terms

provenance.notes: Procedural proxy added with the nightshades work (2026-10-17): every character from the floras in the nightshades notes (plantgen-claude project-files/nightshades/SOURCES.md), drawn by the rules its taxa hold; drawing values only where no character says them.

taxon.note: WCVP v16 accepted name Solanum melongena, plant_name_id 3032200 (Library 1.0 list, read 2026-10-17).

growth_form.note: Its habit as the floras describe it, drawn by the forb form.

growth.note: Grown to the age it is drawn at: an annual's one season, a perennial's or shrub's few years.

variants.note: One seed in the open, as the built-in species.

generator.params.note: Drawing values no character gives (nightshades, 2026-10-17): one plant from one seed; stem 16 mm at the foot, seven leaves below the first cluster and two side shoots, by eye from photographs (iNaturalist 133102788), Bailey (vol. 6 p. 3182) calling it much branched.

allometry.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 6 (1914-17), Solanum Melongena, p. 3182 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): 2-3 ft; Wikipedia 'Eggplant': 40-150 cm. Its reference height is the middle of that range, 0.75 m, at its last keyframe.

traits.life_span.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 2 (1914-17), Eggplant, p. 1101 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): a perennial herb or subshrub grown as a garden annual.

traits.height_typical_m.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 6 (1914-17), Solanum Melongena, p. 3182 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): 2-3 ft; Wikipedia 'Eggplant': 40-150 cm.

traits.sympodial_unit_leaves.note: Two leaves on each unit between clusters, from photographs (iNaturalist 133102788); no source read this session counts them.

traits.leaf_shape.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 6 (1914-17), Solanum Melongena, p. 3182 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): leaves large, ovate or oblong-ovate.

traits.leaf_incision.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 6 (1914-17), Solanum Melongena, p. 3182 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): shallowly sinuate-lobed; Flora of British India (p. 235): sinuate or lobed.

traits.leaf_length_m.note: Wikipedia, 'Eggplant' (read 2026-10-17): leaves 10-20 cm long, over 30 cm in semi-wild types; Flora of British India: 3-6 in.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: Wikipedia, 'Eggplant' (read 2026-10-17): 5-10 cm broad; Flora of British India: 2-4 in.

traits.petiole_length_m.note: Flora of British India vol. 4 (Clarke, 1883-85), Solanum Melongena, p. 235 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): petiole 1 in.

traits.bark_colour.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 6 (1914-17), Solanum Melongena, p. 3182 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): woolly or scurfy and spiny; the stems grey-green in photographs (iNaturalist 205124070). The colour is our reading.

traits.leaf_colour.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 6 (1914-17), Solanum Melongena, p. 3182 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): woolly or scurfy, nearly glabrous above, densely tomentose beneath; photographs (iNaturalist 133102788) grey-green. The colour is our reading.

traits.inflorescence.note: Flora of British India vol. 4 (Clarke, 1883-85), Solanum Melongena, p. 235 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): cymes lateral, few-flowered; Bailey: mostly solitary in cultivated plants.

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: Flora of British India vol. 4 (Clarke, 1883-85), Solanum Melongena, p. 235 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): 1-5 fruits on a peduncle in escapes.

traits.inflorescence_length_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: inflorescence 2-5 cm, widened to its flowers.

traits.flower_size_m.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 6 (1914-17), Solanum Melongena, p. 3182 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): corolla 1 in or more across; Flora of British India 1-1.5 in.

traits.flower_colour.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 6 (1914-17), Solanum Melongena, p. 3182 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): corolla purplish; Flora of British India: blue. The colour is our reading of the words.

traits.fruit_size_m.note: Flora of British India vol. 4 (Clarke, 1883-85), Solanum Melongena, p. 235 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): cultivated berries 1-9 in; Britton and Brown: up to 6 in.

traits.fruit_width_m.note: An egg-shaped berry (Wikipedia, Bailey) about half as wide as long; our reading of 'egg-shaped', no width read.

traits.fruit_colour_ripe.note: Wikipedia, 'Eggplant' (read 2026-10-17): a glossy purple berry; Bailey: purple, white, yellowish or striped. The colour is our reading of the word.

traits.fruit_posture.note: iNaturalist observation 296012680 (CC-licensed photograph, viewed 2026-10-17): the fruit hang. No text read gives it.

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it: flowers June-September.

traits.calyx_in_fruit.note: Flora of British India vol. 4 (Clarke, 1883-85), Solanum Melongena, p. 235 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): the calyx lobes enlarge in fruit, usually much shorter than the fruit and often prickly.

traits.fruiting_months.note: Bailey, Standard Cyclopedia of Horticulture vol. 2 (1914-17), Eggplant, p. 1102 (read on the Internet Archive, 2026-10-17): sow 120 to 150 days before the fruit is wanted, set out when the weather allows, and pinch the blossoms three weeks before frost so the fruit sizes; so fruit from August until the frost. The months are our reading of the days.
